label: Whichever single sense maxime takes, a MAXIME_1 being causes being in all others
description: Optional summary over MAXIME_1-3. Coverage reads both uses of the superlative (existence, causal) in selected senses; exclusivity makes them one sense, so the witness of the existence use falls under the causal use and causes being in every other being; whichever sense it is, the witness is MAXIMAL in being, directly or through a sense bridge. The controls give a model of coverage without exclusivity (existence MAXIMAL, causal GREATEST-degree, incomparable degrees) in which the conclusion fails.
